title: Yellowish Light Ukrainian Beef Pilaf
description: A tangy and creamy Ukrainian dish featuring beef stock and served on a hot stone plate, pescatarian friendly by substituting beef with fish stock if needed.

ingredients.name: beef stock
ingredients.notes: or fish stock for pescatarian version

instructions: Preheat the hot stone plate in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat and add chopped onion, cooking until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add grated carrots and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in butter and slightly toasted.
Add beef stock, one cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each cup to be absorbed before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking the rice, stir in heavy cream and dried dill weed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Remove the hot stone plate from the oven and carefully spoon the pilaf onto the plate.
